author: castone01

title: Perfect private tour with Alberto
text: Alhambra is amazing. Full of history and amazing sights to see. I strongly recommend using a guide. You will miss out on many amazing facts. We had the best experience with Alberto. He helped us dive into Alhambra and the three hours tour was perfect.
author: Jan_S

title: Awesome Alhambra Tour with Great Guide
text:
We had a great 3 hours private tour with Andazari Tours, with Husein as our guide.

Our group consists of 7 people including my parents, both in their 70's, and Husein was very considerate and accomodating.

Husein's knowledge of Alhambra is also very rich & deep, that we gladly learned while enjoying the views.

I'd recommend this tour for everyone!
author: BudiNasron
